newsitem.title: USA: John Malone to try to control Liberty Media - NYT.
newsitem.headline: John Malone to try to control Liberty Media - NYT.

text.p: Eager to assure greater control of the stock of Liberty Media Corp, John Malone, the chairman of the cable programming company, has told associates he wants to gain the stake left by the late Bob Magness, The New York Times reported Friday.
Malone controls 18 percent of the company's votes and the Magness estate held Liberty stock representing 26 percent of the voting power, with a market value of about $300 million, the newspaper said.
Malone intends to acquire a portion of the stake himself and have the company buy the balance and retire it, the newspaper said.
Magness, Liberty's largest shareholder, died in November.
